reuse.why: All month-wide actions use the shared category selector, while the new action reuses existing tag, month, spreadsheet, budget-write and undo abstractions.

duplication.why: Repeated category-selection queries are consolidated, although the new action repeats the income eligibility guard already present in other actions.

placement.why: Budget policy stays in budget/actions.ts and method registration uses the existing app.ts wrappers.

scope.why: The changes are confined to the requested month-wide actions, their registration, tests and release notes.

maintainability.why: The shared selector and narrowly scoped hidden-category option make future exclusions straightforward, though income eligibility remains distributed across callers.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every affected month-wide action calls getMonthWideBudgetCategories, and the new method uses the existing mutation and undo wrappers.

disguised_duplication.where: Category-selection duplication is actually removed; the remaining repeated income guard is explicit.

abstraction_drift.where: getMonthWideBudgetCategories gains the requested includeHiddenCategories option and its conditional hidden filter, without consumer-specific exceptions or bypasses.
